properties.description:
Self-Hosted Integration Runtime to reach Docker SQL Server (localhost:1433).
                   Install SHIR on the same machine running Docker.
                   Download: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=39717

                   Install steps:
                   1. Download SHIR MSI from the link above
                   2. Install on the host machine (where Docker is running)
                   3. Register with the auth key shown in ADF portal:
                      ADF → Manage → Integration Runtimes → IR_SelfHosted_OnPrem → Keys
                   4. Verify: Status shows 'Running' in ADF portal
